concerns.text: SC-004 states 'Peak memory usage during training remains within acceptable system limits.' This is unmeasurable. 'Acceptable' is subjective and undefined. It must specify a quantitative threshold (e.g., '≤ 7GB') to be verifiable.

SC-005 requires 'p < 0.05 correlation' for feature importance. Correlation (Pearson/Spearman) measures linear/monotonic relationships, not the non-linear feature importance derived from GNNs (which requires SHAP/Permutation as per Constitution VII). The metric is methodologically mismatched to the model type, making the success criterion unverifiable for the intended GNN analysis.

Success Criteria SC-001, SC-002, and SC-003 reference specific numbers (>1,000, <15%, <100ms). While these are measurable, the spec lacks a definition for the 'test set' composition in SC-002 (e.g., 'unseen chemical families' needs a concrete definition of what constitutes a 'family' to verify the split).
